title: For "no need" in that...
content_text:
For "no need" in that sentence, I keep defaulting to "don't need to" — but the correct reading was "don't design around BearEcho's format".
That line nails the current state of AI agents.
Do we already have a cron for pruning slop? Isn't that overlapping with the notes loop?
As you know, my phone is a Xiaomi 14 Ultra.
I'm wondering what else this phone can do for fun.
I don't play mobile games anymore, and I've uninstalled all the short-video apps — even Bilibili.
At this point, what I actually use is WeChat and X — the rest I barely touch.
Beyond that, what else do you think a phone is good for?
